audit.whatIsWrong: Lane-difficulty framing is fine at 7.5/10, but the stage-by-stage read contradicts itself: full phases[0] says 'Q-poke wins level 1 outright' while phases[0].side is Ryze, and phases[4] describes a Gragas kill window while side is Ryze.
audit.why: Gragas at 52.11% over 284 games is a slight lane winner who loses scaling; the packet levelChart (Skill, Gragas, Skill, Gragas, Gragas, Gragas, Ryze) matches the prose and both charts should follow it.
audit.corrected: Level 1 even, Level 2 Gragas, Level 3 even, Levels 4-5 Gragas, Level 6 Gragas, first item Gragas, two items Ryze.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was charted as Ryze's stage. Realm Warp (R) is a delayed teleport portal, not a combat ultimate — it adds nothing to a 1v1 at 6, while Explosive Cask does.
audit.why: Riot text: 'Ryze creates a portal to a nearby location. After a few seconds, allies standing near the portal are teleported.' Its only combat effect is the passive Overload bonus vs Flux targets.
audit.corrected: Level 6 is a Gragas spike; Ryze's real spike is two items plus mana stacking, which is where the lane flips.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction is never stated: Rune Prison (W) only ROOTS if Spell Flux (E) is already on the target — otherwise it is a damage-and-slow.
audit.why: Riot text on W: 'If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted.' Avoiding or clearing the E orb downgrades his entire lockdown, which is the pivot of every Gragas engage here.
audit.corrected: Dodge Spell Flux and Rune Prison is only a slow; his root window is gated on landing E first. W cooldown 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text quotes a 13-second Body Slam cooldown.
audit.why: Gragas E is 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s — 14s at rank 1, which is the rank that matters for a whiffed early E.
suspectNames flagged 'Body Slam's', 'Realm Warps' and 'Use Explosive Cask' — all three are false positives; the names match the kits exactly.

edits.before: Q-poke from range wins level 1 outright. Identify how Ryze contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Level 1 is even: Barrel Roll trades with Overload and Happy Hour has no trigger yet. Deny last-hits, dodge his orb.

edits.before: Explosive Cask both finishes kills and deletes engages — you choose the fight. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Ryze's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Level 6 is yours — Body Slam's stun into the empowered auto, Barrel Roll and Explosive Cask kills. Realm Warp is a travel portal, not a fight answer.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Ryze carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items in, Ryze takes over — Overload resets off Spell Flux out-range you. Carry threat 8.5/10: peel with Cask, never 1v1 him.

edits.before: His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: It roots only if Spell Flux hit you first — dodge the orb and his 9-second root is only a slow.

edits.before: Track Ryze's Rune Prison: His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. When it is down — E-slam + Q burst.
edits.after: Rune Prison roots only through Spell Flux — dodge the orb and it is just a slow. Root down: Body Slam into Barrel Roll.

edits.before: Body-slamming INTO his answer — a whiffed E is 13 seconds of being a barrel with no plan.
edits.after: Body-slamming into a held Rune Prison — a whiffed E is 14 seconds with no escape.

edits.before: Body-slamming INTO his answer — a whiffed E is 13 seconds of being a barrel with no plan.
edits.after: Body-slamming into a held Rune Prison — a whiffed E is 14 seconds with no escape.

edits.before: His Overload poke and Rune Prison root let him chip and peel, while your maxed combo isn't fully online yet, so the trade reads roughly even at this stage.
edits.after: His Overload chips and Rune Prison peels, but the root needs Spell Flux on you first — dodge the orb and it is a slow, so level 3 reads roughly even.

edits.before: His danger window — full-stacked Ryze spams Overload with E-flux resets, holds Rune Prison to peel your Body Slam, and Realm Warps flanks, kiting your clunky combo until you can't reach him.
edits.after: His danger window — full-stacked Ryze spams Overload off Spell Flux resets, saves Rune Prison to root your Body Slam the moment the orb sticks, and kites your 12-second E out of range.

notes: packet suspectNames for this matchup are all false positives — Body Slam, Realm Warp and Explosive Cask are the real names. Level-chart flips are proposed as one group per side.
